policy.conditionFormula: 100 × sum(measured area × defect multiplier) ÷ eligible category area
policy.rounding: Nearest tenth; category scores and the raw overall remain unrounded
policy.finalGradeFormula: Round the raw overall directly to the nearest 0.5; exact quarter-point ties round upward. The tenth-point detail is not an intermediate input.
policy.marginalEffectMeaning: Removing this measured region from the current totals may cross a score band. These effects are not additive; overlap ownership is not remeasured.
